name: x_upload_video
description: Upload a video or animated GIF so a post can carry it. COSTS MONEY. Takes a path to a file on this machine and does the whole chunked upload — initialize, one call per 4 MB segment, finalize, then waiting while X transcodes — and returns { data: { id } } once the media is usable. Pass that id to x_post as --media_ids. One video or one GIF per post. mp4, mov, webm or gif; use x_upload_media for a still image. A large file takes minutes: call it once and wait rather than starting again.

media.description: Path to the video on this machine, e.g. './out/clip.mp4'.

media_category.description: 'tweet_video' (default) for a normal post, 'tweet_gif' for an animated GIF, 'amplify_video' for an ads creative.
